events.title: Paul Walsh scores a hat-trick for 리버풀 in their 6–2 home league win over 노리치 시티. 노팅엄 포리스트 remain top of the table with a 3–2 home win over 셰필드 웬즈데이. 아스널 go second with a 2–0 away win over 찰턴 애슬레틱. 맨체스터 유나이티드 draw 1–1 at home to 코번트리 시티 and remain fourth from bottom. 윔블던's return to form continues with a 2–1 win over 토트넘 홋스퍼 at White Hart Lane .

사우샘프턴 beat 맨체스터 유나이티드 4–1 in a League Cup third round replay at The Dell , with the 18-year-old striker Matt Le Tissier scoring his first two goals for the club. The result increases speculation that United manager Ron Atkinson's dismissal is imminent.
Ron Atkinson is sacked after five years as manager of 맨체스터 유나이티드, and Aberdeen's 알렉스 퍼거슨 is appointed as his replacement. Out of favour 웨스트햄 유나이티드 striker Paul Goddard joins 뉴캐슬 유나이티드 for £450,000.
알렉스 퍼거슨 is appointed manager of 맨체스터 유나이티드

맨체스터 유나이티드 lose 2–0 to 옥스퍼드 유나이티드 in their first game under the management of 알렉스 퍼거슨. 리버풀 move to the top of the First Division after a 3–1 win at 퀸스 파크 레인저스, leading on goals scored after 노팅엄 포리스트 lose 1–0 at 코번트리 시티.

England under-21s begin their European Championship qualifying campaign with a 1–1 draw with Yugoslavia at London Road , Peterborough . Their only goal comes from Brighton & Hove Albion striker Terry Connor on his debut at this level.
England beat Yugoslavia 2–0 at Wembley in their second World Cup qualifier.
크리스털 팰리스 sign 레스터 시티 striker Mark Bright for £75,000.

The FA Cup first round sees non-league sides Caernarfon Town and Telford United both beat Football League opposition, while several ties between non-league and Football League opposition end in draws. Non-league Fareham Town lose 7–2 to Third Division promotion contenders 본머스 at Dean Court . 아스널 go top of the First Division with a 4–0 win at 사우샘프턴. 루턴 타운 climb into fourth place and are just two points off the top of the table after beating 노팅엄 포리스트 4–2 at Kenilworth Road . 웨스트햄 유나이티드 keep up their title challenge with a 1–0 win over 윔블던 at Plough Lane . A Second Division promotion crunch game at Elland Road sees 올덤 애슬레틱 go top of the table with a 2–0 win over 리즈 유나이티드.
리버풀 blow their chance to return to the top of the First Division after being held to a 1–1 draw at home to 셰필드 웬즈데이.
윔블던 sign the 21-year-old midfielder Vinnie Jones from Conference side Wealdstone for £10,000.
울버햄프턴 원더러스 continue their rebuilding process and bid for promotion from the Fourth Division by signing midfielder Andy Thompson and striker Steve Bull from neighbours 웨스트브로미치 앨비언 for £35,000 each.

아스널 remain top of the First Division with a 3–0 home win over 맨체스터 시티. 노팅엄 포리스트 keep up the pressure in second place with a 3–2 home win over 윔블던. 첼시, title contenders last season, fall into second from bottom place with a 3–1 home defeat to bottom club 뉴캐슬 유나이티드. 레스터 시티's relegation fears deepen with a 5–1 defeat to 왓퍼드 at Vicarage Road . A John Sivebaek goal gives 알렉스 퍼거슨 his first win as 맨체스터 유나이티드 manager as they beat 퀸스 파크 레인저스 1–0 at Old Trafford and climb out of the bottom four. 토트넘 홋스퍼 get back on track with a 4–2 away win over 옥스퍼드 유나이티드.
The Merseyside derby at Goodison Park ends in a goalless draw.
Jan Molby scores a hat-trick of penalties in 리버풀's 3–1 League Cup quarter-final win over 코번트리 시티 at Anfield.

Vinnie Jones scores his first goal for 윔블던 in a 1–0 victory over 맨체스터 유나이티드 at Plough Lane . 아스널 remain top with a 4–0 away win over 애스턴 빌라. 노팅엄 포리스트 keep up the pressure with a 3–2 away win over 토트넘 홋스퍼. 에버턴 keep up the pace with the leaders by beating 맨체스터 시티 3–1 at Maine Road .

아스널 finish November as First Division leaders, while fifth placed 루턴 타운 are putting up an unlikely title challenge. 노팅엄 포리스트, 에버턴, 리버풀 and 노리치 시티 are also all within five points of the leaders. 뉴캐슬 유나이티드 are bottom, with 첼시 also struggling in the relegation zone. 올덤 애슬레틱 and 포츠머스 continue to lead the way in the Second Division, with 플리머스 아가일 and 리즈 유나이티드 still occupying the play-off zone, joined by 더비 카운티 . The only action of the day sees 뉴캐슬 유나이티드 beat 웨스트햄 유나이티드 4–0 on Tyneside to climb from 22nd to 18th in the First Division.
